contracts: Independent non-owner denial/no-publication assertions and the matched current-owner positive control pass through the actual lifecycle boundary.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Author independent CER-marked S27 cases at the real lifecycle publication boundary. With all other inputs valid, request acceptance-passed as a component different from the independently resolved current owner; fail with NONOWNER_PUBLICATION_NOT_DENIED if denial is absent or any success output, pointer advance or success event occurs. Run the matched current-owner positive control to reject deny-all or unreachable implementations. Missing approvals, setup failures and malformed fixture inputs are not expected RED.
